question: For the IPv4 subnet with ID '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48' (and considering only routes whose next hop is '10.30.19.197/8'), list the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, each allocation pool’s first and last IP, the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by subnet ID), and the allocation-pool FIRST_IP range and variance for that subnet name. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    s.id AS subnet_id,
    s.name AS subnet_name,
    s.tenant_id,
    s.network_id,
    s.ip_version,
    s.cidr,
    s.gateway_ip,
    s.enable_dhcp,
    s.standard_attr_id,
    p.first_ip AS pool_first_ip,
    p.last_ip AS pool_last_ip
  FROM subnets s
  JOIN subnetroutes r ON r.subnet_id = s.id
  JOIN ipallocationpools p ON p.subnet_id = s.id
  WHERE s.id = '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'
    AND s.ip_version = 4
    AND r.nexthop = '10.30.19.197/8'
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT 
    b.*,
    MAX(b.standard_attr_id) OVER (ORDER BY b.subnet_id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_std_attr_id_window
  FROM base b
),
aggregates AS (
  SELECT 
    subnet_name,
    MAX(pool_first_ip) - MIN(pool_first_ip) AS first_ip_range,
    VARIANCE(pool_first_ip) AS first_ip_variance
  FROM base
  GROUP BY subnet_name
)
SELECT 
  w.subnet_name,
